items.text: Notice: Due to road construction on College Avenue, the campus shuttle will follow a detour from March 3 to March 7. The temporary route will stop at the Student Center, the Gymnasium, and the Library. Regular service resumes on March 8.

questions.stem: According to the notice, when does the shuttle detour begin?
questions.explanation: The notice states that the detour occurs from March 3 to March 7, so it begins on March 3.

questions.stem: According to the notice, which stops are included on the temporary route?

options.A: The Student Center, the Gymnasium, and the Library
options.B: The Student Center, the College Avenue, and the Library
options.C: The Gymnasium, the Library, and the Bookstore
options.D: The Student Center, the Bookstore, and the Gymnasium

questions.explanation: The notice lists the Student Center, the Gymnasium, and the Library as the temporary stops.

items.text: Notice: The heating and cooling system in Owens Hall will undergo maintenance on February 15-16. Temperatures may fluctuate between 55 and 85 degrees Fahrenheit during this period. Please dress accordingly. All windows must remain closed to prevent equipment damage.

questions.stem: According to the notice, what is expected about temperatures in Owens Hall during the maintenance?

options.A: They will remain at a constant 70 degrees
options.C: They may vary from 55 to 85 degrees

questions.explanation: The notice explicitly states that temperatures may fluctuate between 55 and 85 degrees Fahrenheit.

questions.stem: What can be inferred about the maintenance work?

options.A: It requires the building's windows to stay shut
options.B: It will cause the building to be completely closed
options.C: It is scheduled to last only one day
options.D: It will be performed by an outside company

questions.explanation: The notice instructs that all windows must remain closed to prevent equipment damage, indicating closing windows is a required condition for the maintenance.

items.text: Save Lives – Donate Blood! Thursday, April 12, 10 AM – 4 PM, University Union Room 101. All donors receive a free T-shirt and a $5 gift card. Walk-ins welcome. Bring your student ID. Sign up online at blooddrive.university.edu.

questions.stem: According to the flyer, what do all blood donors receive?

options.B: A free T-shirt and a $5 gift card

questions.explanation: The flyer states that all donors will receive a free T-shirt and a $5 gift card.

questions.stem: What can be inferred from the flyer?

options.A: Donors must make an appointment in advance
options.B: The blood drive will be held outdoors
options.C: Walk-in donors are permitted at the event
options.D: Only students with a university ID may attend

questions.explanation: The flyer says 'Walk-ins welcome,' which implies that advance registration is not required and people can simply come.
